'''Adnama''', a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|of]]<ref name="Databank" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Databank" /> with light skin and [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> they were a patron<ref name="Databank" /> of the [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall known as the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> on their homeworld.<ref name="Databank" /> While she visited, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club trying to escape the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after her [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. Adnama talked and drank with another Human as the two Jedi talked with each other after entering the Outlander. During the woman's visit, they wore dark-colored [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a high-collar.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adnama first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'',<ref name="AOTC" /> where they were portrayed by [[Amanda Lucas]], the daughter of ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/profile/f20051221/index.html|text=The Force Runs Strong In This Family: Jett, Amanda & Katie}}</ref> in a scene shot in post-production.<ref name="365Days">''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]''</ref> The character was first identified in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]], another character played by Lucas. The entry was published on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="Terr">{{DB|character|terrtaneel|Taneel, Terr}}</ref> on [[May 11]], [[2005]].<ref name="DBDate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050511.html|text=Unrest in the Senate}}</ref>
